description: Cs₂NaSmF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Cs is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SmF₆ octahedra. All Cs-F bond lengths are 3.29 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SmF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.39 Å. Sm is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form SmF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent CsF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sm-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent Cs, one Na, and one Sm atom.
